stories.title: F1 betting: Antonelli is champion, but can he conquer the Strip?
stories.summary: The Las Vegas course, which looks like an upside-down pig, features 17 turns over 3.853 miles, weaving through one of the most famous streets in North America.

stories.title: Billion-dollar water rights ruling could ‘plunge the state into crisis,’ lawyer says
stories.summary: A judge’s ruling in the long-running Coyote Springs fight could expose Nevada taxpayers to more than $1 billion in damages and reshape how the state manages water rights for years to come.

stories.title: Deadly heat, broken ACs and rising bills: Why Nevada’s seniors are at risk
stories.summary: Older Nevadans are increasingly vulnerable to extreme heat, and advocates say stronger protections for air conditioning, utility shutoffs and housing could save lives.

stories.title: Churchill County football caps undefeated season with 3A state title
stories.summary: Churchill County claimed the 3A state football title Friday with a comeback win against Spring Creek at Allegiant Stadium.

stories.title: Smart technology, timeless materials shape ’26 kitchen design trends
stories.summary: Today, the kitchen is not simply a room where meals are prepared. The kitchen is becoming one of the most technology-based rooms from tech-driven gadgets and attractive backsplashes to hidden power outlets and specialty cooking zones.

stories.title: Raiders at Broncos preview: Fernando Mendoza hits the road for the first time
stories.summary: Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza will make his first road start in the same place his coach Klint Kubiak used to watch his father, Gary, coach the Denver Broncos.

stories.title: Las Vegas’ deepest straw at Lake Mead is about to go 30 feet deeper
stories.summary: Divers, cranes and robot submarines will help Southern Nevada lower its Lake Mead intake another 30 feet as officials prepare for a drier Colorado River future. It will cost ratepayers nearly $21 million.

stories.title: ‘It’s a blessing’: Mater East heads to Reno to play Galena for 4A football title
stories.summary: Mater East’s football team will travel to chilly Reno to face Galena for the Class 4A football state championship. It’s the first football title game appearance for Mater East.

stories.title: LA rattled by magnitude 4.2 earthquake felt over a wide area
stories.summary: Southern California was jolted awake by a 4.2-magnitude earthquake that rattled the Los Angeles area Friday morning.
